# gramlot 0.3.9 — Editors and filesystem IDE

Adds the optional editors collection: CodeMirror with configurable options, HTML/Jodit and Markdown rich editing, and sandboxed document previews. The optional Typst collection supplies syntax editing, SVG preview and PDF generation in the browser, including bundled compiler/fonts for offline exports.

The reusable filesystem tree and IDE use lazy directory Bags, six recent workspaces, independent document drafts, explicit Save/Revert, Undo/Redo, dirty-close veto and new-document creation. Filesystem access and persistence remain integration responsibilities. Named Logic methods are supported by shared callback hooks, without weakening inline Source trust checks.

Typst is a separate, approximately 41 MiB uncompressed optional browser collection. Project imports, external packages and arbitrary asset loading are not provided. Python recipe execution requires a Python integration and the separately installed genro-typst package; serverless uses Typst source directly.

Preserves the published tree/navigation, resolver, adapter and Source identity contracts. Database selectors and legacy integration experiments are excluded.
